QF.id: VI Functions of DP Account Opening_57

question.text: Can foreign entities or non-residents open demat accounts in India?

answer.text: Yes, subject to FEMA/RBI guidelines, with CIN optional and passport copies for directors in lieu of DIN
No, demat accounts are only for resident Indians
Only for entities listed on both Indian and foreign exchanges
Only with prior SEBI approval on a case-by-case basis

explanation.text: The Logic: Foreign entities and non-residents can be account holders subject to RBI/FEMA guidelines and required documentation. CIN is optional for foreign entities, and passport copies are accepted in lieu of DIN. The Trap: Restricting demat accounts to resident Indians or requiring case-by-case SEBI approval is not supported. Note: Documentation must establish FEMA/RBI compliance; CIN is optional and passport may substitute for DIN.
